content_zh:
第536章这是个陷阱！
顾晦选择逃走，其实是圈套。
肆意窜动的混乱光旋余波中，乱石炸裂的废墟下，面色彰显苍白的穆斐身前上空，一道年轻的身影凌傲于此。
“既然赤木族当年与神尊有过接触，我便不隐瞒，我不是神尊，姓易，名辰，神尊已经陨落。”易辰非常直接说道。
如燕到有些担忧，不过她家公主肯出去散散心，其实也是好的，反正出去自然有侍卫随行，到也不会出什么大事。
湖州也算是大城，出城进城的人，都要路过此地，越堵越多，马车进退维谷，众人只得停下来看热闹。
“应该是你拿回来的路上已经开始融化，只是一路晃悠却没渗出来，反而静静摆放了一会儿，倒是流出来了。”公孙拿着一把竹夹子轻轻戳了戳箱子的底部，感觉有松动，四周还有些缝隙，像是有两层。
白玉堂听着天尊和殷候讲当年灭妖后的事情，就感觉有人靠近，转脸一看……展昭骑着多多，不知什么时候挨着白云帆并排一起走着。
说话的时候，林淮步闭上了眼睛，等他再次睁开眼睛的时候，已经是身在加拿大唐人街的一家清真馆子门前。深深的吸了口气之后，林淮步推开门走了进去。
“喵……”婴灵痛苦的惨叫了起来，倒在地上挣扎了起来，一阵红光渐渐的被拉出了婴灵的灵外，不过时而进时而出的，总是飘忽不定，在一边的梁大生也痛苦的呻吟了起来，倒在地上满地打滚了起来。
如燕听见屋里发出一声呻吟，犹豫了下，轻轻推门而入，就见十三公主靠在床上，香肩裸露，身上衣衫凌乱不堪，满脸的迷蒙。
陡然见如此美艳佳人，气质儒雅，陆落和闻氏都觉得可能是淳宁郡主。
距离上一次东荒大帝出现的时间，已经过去了好几年，没想到，现在他竟然又出现了。
可以说雕刻紫矿石是对功力深厚，功力控制以及大局观的一个综合性考察，综合性最强的人就是这次获胜者。
宁海操控着影子战士从正面朝四名玩家扑去。看到一个黑影猛的从黑暗中冲出，几名玩家没想到这个盗贼居然如此强悍，急忙开始应敌。
“这…”幻霜刚想说出直接退兵的话，但是一迎上林显扬那要杀人的眼神，幻霜又不得不把自己想说的话憋了回去。
现在他的修为虽然是金丹中期，这也只是凭借秘术提升上来的，为的就是能和宗晋有一战之力。
于是叶起很清楚，剑宗反倒是其次，正一道派和七纵魔宗的所谓天魔陛下，才是真正的始作俑者。
林南心中疑惑，同时还有一个念头忽然蹦了出来：东阳卫李显一夜激战，他们在哪儿？是出现在其他地方了还是仍旧在暗中隐藏？一边这样想着，林南下意识地转过身，目光朝着后方的都指挥使骆天看去。
第536章这是个陷阱！

“黒鸦？我怎么从来没有听说过！”刘驽吃了一惊，他没有想到自己曾经奉为挚友的狄辛竟有这样一副不为人知的面目。
叶起穿着一身黑袍，周围的人渐渐多了起来，除去本身就是结伴而来的之外，大多都管着自己飞行赶路，没人交谈，财不露白，在这里来往的人大多都心机深沉，不愿意横生枝节。
首先他们两个简单介绍了里面的情况，蚣厌月就住在乱石岗最中央的一块石头缝隙里，他哥哥蜈厌日住在隔壁的石缝里，他现在是白天狩猎，晚上在住地巡视一番，大约午夜后会进洞休息。
“别，别杀我。”红泪的声音有些颤抖，但是，说话的时候，甚至是充斥着一抹娇羞。
鲍斯嘴角又上扬了一些，却是扒开了自己的衣服，露出自己的胸膛。
自己入了冷宫之后，连带梁家也遭了罪。父亲虽然没有降职，但却处处遭到排挤，如今她重回宫廷，还身怀龙种，这才没人再敢刁难梁家。
怎么说呢？原来当事情的真相彻底揭开。隐藏在下面的真面目，居然是如此恐怖。
也不知道那是什么令牌，但张仪琳一见到那令牌，面色突变，也不敢再跑过来，而是低头作揖行礼，其他灵师也是如此，很明显那块令牌并不简单。
“那就是我忘了！”薛城抽出腰间别着的匕首，刺啦一声划开了门上的锁链，推开那扇木门，一步步的靠近躺在地上难以动弹的宁王。
明念边走边撕扯着自己的衣服，刚一进房间就迫不及待地朝着眼前的人墙扑了过去。
“行，那到时候你成功了跟我说一声，我给你送行呀。”萧晓奇笑道。
顾笙歌惊喜的转过去，连忙对着应瑶的方向道：“我在这”，说完撒腿就跑。
柳青青摸了摸自己的脸，悄悄松了口气，她平日里在娱乐圈是艳光十色的大明星，今天为了这次的约会，特意画了清秀的妆，还费心取了下巴上垫的东西，化得她都认不出自己了。
傅易愠忽的伸手，一掌击向老二，老三急忙出手挡住，只听见三根银针插进树干中，树干颜色瞬间发紫，所有人一惊，均收起了笑容，一脸警惕的看着傅易愠。
他怒极反笑，就算他迁怒又怎么了，更何况，她就真的这么笃定她爸爸没做错什么吗？蓝颜风用可怜的眼神看向白冉冉，似乎在看什么可怜虫一样。
“你是真不知道，还是在和我装傻？”蓝颜风瞬间脸色突变，显然对白冉冉的回答非常的不悦。

Chapter 536 This is a trap!
Gu Hui's choice to escape was actually a trap.
In the aftermath of the chaotic light swirling wildly, under the ruins of exploding rocks, a young figure stood proudly in the sky in front of Mu Fei, who looked pale.
"Since the Chimu clan had contact with the deity back then, I will not hide it. I am not the deity. My surname is Yi and my name is Chen. The deity has fallen." Yi Chen said very directly.
Ru Yan was a little worried, but it was actually good that her princess was willing to go out to relax. Anyway, she would be accompanied by guards when she went out, so nothing big would happen when she arrived.
Huzhou is also a big city. People who go out or enter the city have to pass by this place. The traffic jams become more and more serious. The carriages are in a dilemma, and everyone has to stop and watch the excitement.
"It must have started to melt on the way you brought it back. It just swayed all the way but didn't seep out. Instead, it was placed quietly for a while, and it did seep out." Gongsun took a bamboo clip and gently poked the bottom of the box. It felt loose, and there were some gaps around it, as if there were two layers.
Bai Yutang listened to Tianzun and Yin Hou talking about the demon queen's past, and felt someone approaching. He turned around and saw... Zhan Zhao was riding Duoduo, and at some point he was walking side by side next to Bai Yunfan.
While talking, Lin Huaibu closed his eyes. When he opened his eyes again, he was already in front of a halal restaurant in Chinatown, Canada. After taking a deep breath, Lin Huaibu opened the door and walked in.
"Meow..." The infant spirit screamed in pain, fell to the ground and struggled. A burst of red light was gradually pulled out of the infant spirit, but it came in and out, always erratic. Liang Dasheng on the side also groaned in pain, fell to the ground and rolled around.
Ruyan heard a moan coming from the room, hesitated for a moment, and gently pushed the door open. She saw the thirteenth princess leaning on the bed, her shoulders exposed, her clothes in a mess, and her face full of confusion.
Suddenly seeing such a beautiful woman with elegant temperament, both Lu Luo and Wen felt that she might be Princess Chunning.
Several years have passed since the last time Emperor Donghuang appeared. Unexpectedly, he would appear again now.
It can be said that carving purple ore is a comprehensive examination of deep skill, skill control and overall view. The person with the strongest comprehensiveness is the winner this time.
Ning Hai controlled the shadow warrior to rush towards the four players from the front. Seeing a black shadow rushing out of the darkness, several players did not expect that the thief was so powerful and hurriedly began to respond to the enemy.
"This..." Huan Shuang was about to say something about retreating directly, but when he met Lin Xianyang's murderous eyes, Huan Shuang had to hold back what he wanted to say.
Although his current cultivation level is in the middle stage of Jindan, he only improved it with the help of secret techniques in order to be able to fight Zong Jin.
So Ye Qi knew very well that the Sword Sect was second, and the so-called Heavenly Demon Majesty of the Zhengdao Sect and the Seven Vertical Demon Sect was the real instigator.
Lin Nan was confused, and at the same time, a thought suddenly popped up: Dongyang Guards and Li Xian fought fiercely all night, where were they? Has it appeared elsewhere or is it still hiding in the dark? While thinking this, Lin Nan turned around subconsciously and looked toward the commander Luo Tian behind him.

"Black Crow? How come I have never heard of it!" Liu Nuo was surprised. He did not expect that Di Xin, whom he once regarded as a close friend, would have such an unknown face.
Ye Qi was wearing a black robe, and there were gradually more people around him. Except for those who came together, most of them were busy flying on their own. No one talked to them, and their wealth was not revealed. Most of the people who came and went here were scheming and unwilling to create complications.
First, the two of them briefly introduced the situation inside. Chu Yanyue lived in a stone crevice in the center of the rocky hill, and his brother Centi Yanri lived in the stone crevice next door., he now hunts during the day, patrols the residence at night, and goes into the cave to rest after about midnight.
"Don't, don't kill me." Hong Lei's voice was trembling, but when she spoke, it was even filled with a hint of shyness.
The corners of Baos' mouth raised a little more, but he took off his clothes and exposed his chest.
After he entered the cold palace, the Liang family also suffered. Although her father was not demoted, he was ostracized everywhere. Now that she has returned to the palace and is pregnant with a dragon, no one dares to make things difficult for the Liang family anymore.
How to say it? It turned out that when the truth of the matter was completely revealed. The true face hidden underneath is actually so terrifying.
She didn't know what the token was, but when Zhang Yilin saw the token, her expression suddenly changed, and she didn't dare to run over again. Instead, she lowered her head and bowed in salute. The same was true for other spiritual masters. It was obvious that the token was not simple.
"Then I forgot!" Xue Cheng took out the dagger from his waist, cut open the chain on the door with a stab, pushed open the wooden door, and stepped closer to Prince Ning, who was lying on the ground unable to move.
Ming Nian tore her clothes as she walked, and as soon as she entered the room, she couldn't wait to rush towards the wall of people in front of her.
"Okay, then when you succeed, tell me and I will see you off." Xiao Xiaoqi said with a smile.
Gu Shengge turned around in surprise, and quickly said in Ying Yao's direction: "I'm here," and then ran away.
Liu Qingqing touched her face and breathed a sigh of relief. She was usually a glamorous star in the entertainment industry. Today, for this date, she specially put on delicate makeup and took the trouble to remove the pad from her chin, making her unrecognizable.
Fu Yimin suddenly stretched out his hand and hit the second child with a palm. The third child hurriedly blocked it. He heard three silver needles inserted into the trunk of the tree. The trunk turned purple instantly. Everyone was startled and put away their smiles. They looked at Fu Yimin warily.
He laughed in anger, so what if he expressed his anger? What's more, was she really so sure that her father had done nothing wrong? Lan Yanfeng looked at Bai Ranran with pitiful eyes, as if he was looking at some poor creature.
"Do you really not know, or are you just pretending to be stupid with me?" Lan Yanfeng's expression suddenly changed, and she was obviously very unhappy with Bai Ranran's answer.
